items.source: Detect beans defined in the given beanFactory that initialize a DataSource.
items.translation: 检测在给定 beanFactory 中定义的初始化了 DataSource 的 Bean。

items.source: Callback indicating that all known DataSourceInitializerDetectors have been called and detection of beans that initialize a DataSource is complete.
items.translation: 指示所有已知的 DataSourceInitializerDetectors 均已被调用，且检测用于初始化 DataSource 的 Bean 已完成。

items.source: Detects beans that initialize an SQL database. Implementations should be registered in META-INF/spring.factories under the key org.springframework.boot.sql.init.dependency.DatabaseInitializerDetector.
items.translation: 检测用于初始化 SQL 数据库的 Bean。实现应在 META-INF/spring.factories 下注册，键为 org.springframework.boot.sql.init.dependency.DatabaseInitializerDetector。

items.source: dataSourceInitializerNames - names of the DataSource initializer beans detected by all known detectors
items.translation: dataSourceInitializerNames - 所有已知检测器检测到的 DataSource 初始化器 Bean 的名称
beanFactory - 被检查的 Bean 工厂

items.source: getOrder in interface Ordered
items.translation: getOrder 接口 Ordered 中
beanFactory - 要检查的 Bean 工厂

items.source: names of the detected DataSource initializer beans, or an empty set if none were detected.
items.translation: 检测到的DataSource初始化器 Bean 的名称，或者如果没有检测到任何 Bean，则为空集。
